Second source URL: https://kyivindependent.com/russian-oil-refineries-reportedly-struck-by-ukraine-in-samara-oblast-krasnodar-krai/
(WebFetch extract of Moscow Times (Reuters-based) article + Kyiv Independent, Aug 8 2026.)

Ukraine strikes two Russian oil refineries overnight, Aug 8 2026.

Refineries targeted:
- Syzran oil refinery (Samara region) - annual capacity ~8.5-8.9 million tons; massive fire reported after multiple explosions.
- Ilsky oil refinery (Krasnodar region) - annual capacity ~6-6.6 million tons; fire reported.

Casualties: Kyiv Independent/Kyiv Post reporting cited five people injured at the Ilsky plant; Moscow Times/Reuters version reported fires at both facilities without casualty figures. Krasnodar local authorities said the Ilsky refinery fire "had been caused by debris from a Ukrainian drone."

Air defence claim: Russia's Defence Ministry said its air defences "destroyed 397 Ukrainian drones over multiple regions overnight."

Officials:
- Ukraine's General Staff said the Ukrainian military struck both refineries, causing fires; Kyiv characterised the strikes as efforts "to deprive Russia of resources to fund its military."
- Samara region governor Vyacheslav Fedorishchev said drones targeted an industrial facility there, without identifying the enterprise.
- Reuters said it "could not independently verify the reports from either side of the conflict."

Zelensky quote (via Kyiv Independent): "our long-range sanctions once again worked to limit Russia's oil revenues, which it uses to finance the war and the killing of Ukrainians."
